title: Not a good value for the amount
text: I have had it for two months. I feel like the brands I received this month aren’t even worth the money. I tried to google it and it’s a company from New Zealand. Product reviews are older so it’s not even a quality active company. I believe these are cheaply purchased items in bulk to create these subscription boxes. Last month I had a bunch of stuff I could have got at Family Dollar. I’ll find another box but this ain’t it.
label: neutral
